Chapter 01The problem

The diary of an ordinary month.

Nothing dramatic goes wrong. Small things slip, and the month closes in a panic.

  1. Day 3

    Sales slips are in a drawer. “I’ll enter them this weekend.”

  2. Day 11

    GSTR-1 date. The invoice list is half in Excel, half in a notebook.

  3. Day 20

    Bank statement arrives. Two payments nobody can explain.

  4. Day 25

    A bag of purchase bills is found in the office car.

  5. Day 30

    Month-end. The owner asks, “Did we make money?” Nobody can say yet.

Chapter 02The turn

Now the same month, with a steady hand.

  • Daily

    Vouchers posted as they happen. Bank matched weekly.

  • By the 7th

    TDS deposited. Payroll posted.

  • By the 11th

    GSTR-1 data reconciled and ready.

  • By the 20th

    GSTR-3B prepared against matched credit.

  • Day 3 next month

    Books closed. The owner reads the P&L.

    FAQ

    Good questions

    Can Sarvlekh maintain our books in Tally?

    Yes. Our accountants maintain books in Tally Prime and keep them in sync with your operations software.

    Do you file GST returns?

    We prepare and reconcile GST returns and support filing workflows; final filing follows your authorisation.

    Can you run payroll for small teams?

    Yes. Payroll, statutory compliance and payslips are included for teams of any size.
